provenance.source: Exact 3.101.043 IDB: startup 0xc0c0ac8 copies [0x2c10d440,0x2c18d940) to PSRAM 0x3c000000, executable alias 0x1c000000. Load address 0xc179f00 maps to runtime 0x1c06cac0, callable 0x1c06cac1; XIP veneer 0xc588d58 independently targets 0x1c06cac1. Runtime body loads image class 0x2cce61ec and invokes native class creation/initialization. It saves incoming R1 and forwards it to class initializer 0x1c029074 as a nullable initialization-options byte pointer. NULL selects the default byte at 0x200c97bc; otherwise the first options byte gates theme initialization. Exact stock callers 0xc4c8284,0xc4ca0fc and 0x1c0703f4 explicitly pass R1=0. The corrected two-argument prototype matches EVID-RESOURCE-XIP-THUNKS-1043-001; the options pointer is borrowed synchronously. Cross-version corpus match and prior exact-function review identify the same body; existing proof, policy, approval, promotion and device metadata are retained.
